exposure: Early CPAP (initiated at half an hour after birth)
Late CPAP (initiated after half an hour after birth)
cohort: 72 preterm neonates born at 28-37 weeks gestation admitted to the NICU of Muzaffarnagar Medical College between January 2019-December 2019
finding: Early CPAP was more effective than late CPAP for the treatment of respiratory distress syndrome, reducing the need for surfactant administration and mechanical ventilation.
